value.uncertainty_explanation: The supplied text contains no express pandemic-response exception. The affirmative covenants and negative covenants have separate introductory exceptions; the Disclosure Schedule exception expressly attaches only to the negative list. Missing Agreement provisions, schedules, definitions and incorporated instruments prevent a legally closed audit of all permitted conduct, including whether any incorporated permission concerns pandemic responses. Section 5.2(iii) expressly limits consent requirements rather than generally excusing the underlying conduct covenants, and its contract-wide reach cannot be fully enumerated from this fragment. No alternative attachment sets are asserted without source support. Company knowledge requires reasonable inquiry, subject to the express patent-investigation limitation; Parent and Merger Sub knowledge remains undefined in the supplied materials.
